item.title: A Note from Us: Updates Now Included in the Overview
item.author: mail@christianmahnke.de (Christian Mahnke)
item.description: Many of the articles on my blog are updated from time to time—for example, in response to reader feedback, new research findings, or when projects or software have evolved. Since there have been more and more of these updates in recent months (and I’ve published fewer regular posts), the updated posts are now also listed in the post index by their update date.
